title: Master Portaless — Practical Guide
description: How to clone Portaless, edit your home page (/) visually, choose between GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Self-host, and leverage strict CSP.

props.title: Get the most out of Portaless
props.subtitle: A practical guide to go from cloning the repository to shipping a fast, visually editable website hardened with strict CSP.

props.text: 1. From zero to live site in 4 steps

props.items:
package :: Clone the starter profile :: Install with npm ci (Node 24) and run npm run build to emit a clean site with zero demo bloat.
server :: Edit the home page (/) visually :: On self-host or Cloudflare Pages + D1, open /admin/editor?slug=home, compose Atomic Elements blocks, and publish live to /.
shield :: Strict CSP out of the box :: Zero inline scripts and zero on*= handlers across static, Cloudflare Pages, and Node self-host.
bot :: Connect AI agents over MCP :: Expose 19 permission-scoped tools so AI clients draft pages under your exact rules.

props.text: 2. Pick the right runtime for your site

props.title: Runtime comparison
props.items:
GitHub Pages (static, free) :: Ideal for personal hubs, portfolios, and blogs authored in Git or edited locally before pushing. Serves compiled HTML with zero server maintenance.
Cloudflare Pages + D1 (dynamic edge) :: Runs functions/ backed by D1: login, /admin, live Visual Editor for / and /pages/<slug>, Trust Layer, and Gatekeeper. Initialize D1 via npm run setup:d1 -- --remote.
Node 24 / Docker self-host (full node) :: Reference runtime with every capability enabled: terminal-less /setup, live Visual Editor, integrated GitHub Pages export (/admin/publish), checksummed SQLite backups, MCP server, and plugin sandbox.
